title: Design and implement agentic loops for autonomous task execution
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: The agentic loop lifecycle: sending requests to Claude, inspecting stop_reason ("tool_use" vs "end_turn"), executing requested tools, and returning results for the next iteration
knowledge.evidence: API19: lifecycle/tool_use/end_turn và ngoại lệ.

knowledge.item: How tool results are appended to conversation history so the model can reason about the next action
knowledge.evidence: API19: lưu assistant rồi user tool results có ID.

knowledge.item: The distinction between model-driven decision-making (Claude reasons about which tool to call next based on context) and pre-con fi gured decision trees or tool sequences
knowledge.evidence: API19/API32: model chọn bước theo context, khác cây quyết định mã hóa.

skills.item: Implementing agentic loop control fl ow that continues when stop_reason is "tool_use" and terminates when stop_reason is "end_turn"
skills.evidence: API19/EXAM14: tiếp tục tool_use, kết thúc end_turn, xử lý reason khác.

skills.item: Adding tool results to conversation context between iterations so the model can incorporate new information into its reasoning
skills.evidence: API19: thêm kết quả từng ID và is_error vào history.

skills.item: Avoiding anti-patterns such as parsing natural language signals to determine loop termination, setting arbitrary iteration caps as the primary stopping mechanism, or checking for assistant text content as a completion indicator
skills.evidence: API19/EXAM14: không parse lời nói, text hoặc cap để chứng minh thành công.

title: Orchestrate multi-agent systems with coordinator-subagent patterns
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: Hub-and-spoke architecture where a coordinator agent manages all inter-subagent communication, error handling, and information routing
knowledge.evidence: Tóm tắt: hub-and-spoke và coordinator định tuyến/xử lý lỗi.

knowledge.item: How subagents operate with isolated context—they do not inherit the coordinator's conversation history automatically
knowledge.evidence: Tóm tắt: context riêng, không tự kế thừa lịch sử.

knowledge.item: The role of the coordinator in task decomposition, delegation, result aggregation, and deciding which subagents to invoke based on query complexity
knowledge.evidence: Tóm tắt: coordinator phân tích, phân việc, chọn nhánh và tổng hợp.

knowledge.item: Risks of overly narrow task decomposition by the coordinator, leading to incomplete coverage of broad research topics
knowledge.evidence: Tóm tắt: chia hẹp quá gây bỏ sót nghiên cứu rộng.

skills.item: Designing coordinator agents that analyze query requirements and dynamically select which subagents to invoke rather than always routing through the full pipeline
skills.evidence: Tóm tắt/Q2: chọn agent theo yêu cầu, không gọi mọi nhánh.

skills.item: Partitioning research scope across subagents to minimize duplication (e.g., assigning distinct subtopics or source types to each agent)
skills.evidence: Tóm tắt: chia theo subtopic/loại nguồn, giảm trùng.

skills.item: Implementing iterative re fi nement loops where the coordinator evaluates synthesis output for gaps, re-delegates to search and analysis subagents with targeted queries, and re-invokes synthesis until coverage is suf fi cient
skills.evidence: Tóm tắt/Q3: tìm gap và giao lại truy vấn có mục tiêu trước tổng hợp.

skills.item: Routing all subagent communication through the coordinator for observability, consistent error handling, and controlled information fl ow
skills.evidence: Tóm tắt/Q2: định tuyến tập trung qua coordinator.

title: Con fi gure subagent invocation, context passing, and spawning
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: The Task tool as the mechanism for spawning subagents, and the requirement that allowedTools must include "Task" for a coordinator to invoke subagents
knowledge.evidence: EXAM01: Task phải có trong allowedTools theo giao diện đề cương.

knowledge.item: That subagent context must be explicitly provided in the prompt—subagents do not automatically inherit parent context or share memory between invocations
knowledge.evidence: EXAM01: prompt chứa context rõ, không shared memory ngầm.

knowledge.item: The AgentDe fi nition con fi guration including descriptions, system prompts, and tool restrictions for each subagent type
knowledge.evidence: EXAM01: AgentDefinition có description/system prompt/tool restrictions.

knowledge.item: Fork-based session management for exploring divergent approaches from a shared analysis baseline
knowledge.evidence: EXAM12: fork tạo nhánh từ baseline chung.

skills.item: Including complete fi ndings from prior agents directly in the subagent's prompt (e.g., passing web search results and document analysis outputs to the synthesis subagent)
skills.evidence: EXAM01/Q1: truyền findings trước vào synthesis prompt.

skills.item: Using structured data formats to separate content from metadata (source URLs, document names, page numbers) when passing context between agents to preserve attribution
skills.evidence: EXAM01: tách findings khỏi URLs/names/pages/date.

skills.item: Spawning parallel subagents by emitting multiple Task tool calls in a single coordinator response rather than across separate turns
skills.evidence: EXAM01: nhiều yêu cầu độc lập cùng lượt cho song song.

skills.item: Designing coordinator prompts that specify research goals and quality criteria rather than step-by- step procedural instructions, to enable subagent adaptability
skills.evidence: EXAM01: giao mục tiêu/tiêu chí chất lượng/phạm vi thay kịch bản cứng.

title: Implement multi-step work fl ows with enforcement and handoff patterns
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: The difference between programmatic enforcement (hooks, prerequisite gates) and prompt-based guidance for work fl ow ordering
knowledge.evidence: Tóm tắt: gate mã khác prompt.

knowledge.item: When deterministic compliance is required (e.g., identity veri fi cation before fi nancial operations), prompt instructions alone have a non-zero failure rate
knowledge.evidence: Tóm tắt/Q1: xác minh tài chính cần cưỡng chế.

knowledge.item: Structured handoff protocols for mid-process escalation that include customer details, root cause analysis, and recommended actions
knowledge.evidence: Handoff: định danh, nguyên nhân, đề xuất cho người không có transcript.

skills.item: Implementing programmatic prerequisites that block downstream tool calls until prerequisite steps have completed (e.g., blocking process_refund until get_customer has returned a veri fi ed customer ID)
skills.evidence: Tóm tắt/Q1: block refund nếu chưa xác minh hợp lệ.

skills.item: Decomposing multi-concern customer requests into distinct items, then investigating each in parallel using shared context before synthesizing a uni fi ed resolution
skills.evidence: Đoạn nhiều vấn đề: tách hạng mục, shared facts, điều tra độc lập song song, tổng hợp.

skills.item: Compiling structured handoff summaries (customer ID, root cause, refund amount, recommended action) when escalating to human agents who lack access to the conversation transcript
skills.evidence: Handoff: customer ID/root cause/refund amount/recommended action rõ ràng.

title: Apply Agent SDK hooks for tool call interception and data normalization
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: Hook patterns (e.g., PostToolUse) that intercept tool results for transformation before the model processes them
knowledge.evidence: EXAM02: PostToolUse chuẩn hóa kết quả trước model.

knowledge.item: Hook patterns that intercept outgoing tool calls to enforce compliance rules (e.g., blocking refunds above a threshold)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM02/14: hook trước tool chặn hành động vượt ngưỡng.

knowledge.item: The distinction between using hooks for deterministic guarantees versus relying on prompt instructions for probabilistic compliance
knowledge.evidence: EXAM02: deterministic enforcement khác compliance xác suất.

skills.item: Implementing PostToolUse hooks to normalize heterogeneous data formats (Unix timestamps, ISO 8601, numeric status codes) from different MCP tools before the agent processes them
skills.evidence: EXAM02/14: Unix/ISO8601/numeric status theo contract và timezone, giữ nguồn.

skills.item: Implementing tool call interception hooks that block policy-violating actions (e.g., refunds exceeding $500) and redirect to alternative work fl ows (e.g., human escalation)
skills.evidence: EXAM02/14: gate trước refund vượt ngưỡng và redirect human.

skills.item: Choosing hooks over prompt-based enforcement when business rules require guaranteed compliance
skills.evidence: EXAM02/Q1: chọn gate/hooks thay prompt khi cần cưỡng chế.

title: Design task decomposition strategies for complex work fl ows
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: When to use fi xed sequential pipelines (prompt chaining) versus dynamic adaptive decomposition based on intermediate fi ndings
knowledge.evidence: API32/34: predictable chaining khác dynamic adaptive plan.

knowledge.item: Prompt chaining patterns that break reviews into sequential steps (e.g., analyze each fi le individually, then run a cross- fi le integration pass)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM08/14: per-file rồi cross-file integration.

knowledge.item: The value of adaptive investigation plans that generate subtasks based on what is discovered at each step
knowledge.evidence: EXAM14: kế hoạch điều tra sinh nhiệm vụ theo findings.

skills.item: Selecting task decomposition patterns appropriate to the work fl ow: prompt chaining for predictable multi-aspect reviews, dynamic decomposition for open-ended investigation tasks
skills.evidence: API32/EXAM14: chọn chaining cho bước biết trước, adaptive cho điều tra mở.

skills.item: Splitting large code reviews into per- fi le local analysis passes plus a separate cross- fi le integration pass to avoid attention dilution
skills.evidence: EXAM08 Q1/Q3: local review rồi integration tránh attention dilution.

skills.item: Decomposing open-ended tasks (e.g., "add comprehensive tests to a legacy codebase") by fi rst mapping structure, identifying high-impact areas, then creating a prioritized plan that adapts as dependencies are discovered
skills.evidence: EXAM14 Q2: map legacy repo, ưu tiên high-impact, cập nhật theo dependencies.

title: Manage session state, resumption, and forking
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: Named session resumption using --resume <session-name> to continue a speci fi c prior conversation
knowledge.evidence: Đoạn bổ sung: --resume <session-name> chọn phiên đặt tên.

knowledge.item: fork_session for creating independent branches from a shared analysis baseline to explore divergent approaches
knowledge.evidence: Tóm tắt: fork_session nhánh độc lập từ baseline.

knowledge.item: The importance of informing the agent about changes to previously analyzed fi les when resuming sessions after code modi fi cations
knowledge.evidence: Đoạn resume: thông báo file đã sửa.

knowledge.item: Why starting a new session with a structured summary is more reliable than resuming with stale tool results
knowledge.evidence: Tóm tắt/Q1: summary mới khi tool results cũ nhiều.

skills.item: Using --resume with session names to continue named investigation sessions across work sessions
skills.evidence: Đoạn bổ sung: resume named investigation theo đề cương.

skills.item: Using fork_session to create parallel exploration branches (e.g., comparing two testing strategies or refactoring approaches from a shared codebase analysis)
skills.evidence: Tóm tắt: fork so sánh phương án độc lập, không đồng bộ findings ngầm.

skills.item: Choosing between session resumption (when prior context is mostly valid) and starting fresh with injected summaries (when prior tool results are stale)
skills.evidence: Tóm tắt/Q1: chọn resume nếu context còn đúng, summary mới nếu stale.

skills.item: Informing a resumed session about speci fi c fi le changes for targeted re-analysis rather than requiring full re-exploration
skills.evidence: Đoạn bổ sung: nêu file thay đổi để targeted re-analysis.
